subject: Rebranding in security warning log (#1945)
reason: The change only substitutes the SERVER_TITLE macro ("Valkey") for the hardcoded string "Redis" in the security-warning log message of securityWarningCommand (networking.c). No reply, connection handling, rate limiting, or any other runtime behaviour changes: the client is still aborted the same way on POST/Host:, and the only difference is the wording of a serverLog line, which no fuzzer oracle observes and which is identical in effect on both builds. This is a cosmetic rebranding of log text and needs no scenario.
